summary: ESP32-C3 Adblock is firmware that runs on ESP32‑C3 devices to block ads locally via DNS. It is built as C++ embedded code compiled into the microcontroller, requiring no external API keys. The tool is suited for IoT developers who need on‑device privacy controls without cloud dependence. It shines with fast installation (10.9 s) and full test pass, but documentation is sparse and integration options are limited to the firmware itself.

github.description: Pi-hole-class DNS ad-blocker on a $2 ESP32-C3 (no PSRAM): 537k domains as 40-bit FNV-1a hashes in flash, binary-searched. UDP DNS sinkhole + web dashboard. https://youtube.com/shorts/RaxszOUMi8E?feature=share
